description: This class is an implementation of the io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap interface, providing a way to extract tracing context information from a JsonObject. It acts as an adapter to allow JsonObject to be used in OpenTracing's context propagation mechanisms.

classes.name: JsonObjectExtractAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that implements TextMap to extract properties from a JsonObject and supply them to tracing systems.

methods.name: JsonObjectExtractAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a JsonObject, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the key-value pairs of the JsonObject, converting Object values to Strings.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Unsupported operation; method throws UnsupportedOperationException when called.
